assignmentHtml.task: Research Anaya Kandhal YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creator - who is Anaya Kandhal? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative works. Provide direct source URLs. This channel has very high view counts (~117B) so investigate its nature carefully.
assignmentHtml.context: Anaya Kandhal is #12 with ~117B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Anaya Kandhal with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
COMPREHENSIVE DOSSIER: ANAYA KANDHAL YOUTUBE CHANNEL

  1. STABLE CHANNEL ID & CANONICAL URL
  • Channel ID: UC4wEPe5mrHGAUjjTfXH_C-Q [1][2]
  • Canonical URL: https://www.youtube.com/@AnayaKandhal (handle-based) [1]
  • Also mirrors at https://www.youtube.com/AnayaKandhal [3]
  1. OPERATOR/CREATOR
  • Channel created and operated by parents Jonyy Kandhara (father) and Preethirana (also referred to as Preeti Irana / Preetrana) (mother) [4][5][6]
  • Daughter Anaya Kandhal (born June 21, 2021, in India) is the central on-screen personality [4][5]
  • Parents manage, curate, and co-star in all content; grandmother also frequently appears [5][6]
  • Contact email: Preetrana1601@gmail.com [7]
  1. CREATION DATE & EARLIEST STILL-PUBLIC UPLOAD
  • Channel created: September 20, 2016 [1][2]
  • Earliest still-public upload: "MY FIRST VLOG ON YOUTUBE || ANAYA KANDHAL" uploaded August 27, 2022, with ~4.2M views [8][9][10]
  • NOTE: ~6-year gap between channel creation and first upload — channel was dormant 2016–2022
  1. OPERATING LOCATION & DISPLAYED COUNTRY
  • Country displayed on YouTube: India (IN) [1][2][7]
  • Wikipedia lists: India [11]
  1. LANGUAGES
  • Primary language: Hindi [11][12]
  1. PRIMARY CONTENT CATEGORY
  • Discrepancy across sources: Wikipedia categorizes as 'Entertainment' [11]; Tubestats lists 'Family, Vlog, Kids' [1]; Vidanalyze lists 'Lifestyle' [7]
  • Actual content: Short-form family comedy skits, pranks, lifestyle vlogs, and moral stories featuring a young Indian child and her multi-generational household [4][5][13]
  1. CONTENT SUPPLY MODEL
  • Very high volume: ~4,500+ public videos [1][2]
  • Overwhelmingly Shorts-driven: In the last 28 days, Shorts generated 3.0B views (97%) vs. Long-form 93.8M views (3%) [14]
  • Daily uploads of short-form, low-production-value family comedy content designed for algorithmic virality [13][14]
  • TubeFilter research identified her as 'the most successful creator on YouTube Shorts' among Indian creators [15]
  • Weekly views regularly exceed 500M–700M (peaked at 732.1M weekly views in April 2024, ranking #1 globally) [4][13]
  1. REPRESENTATIVE WORKS
  • 'Anaya or Papa Ne ki Masti' — 4.19B views, uploaded Nov 8, 2023 — among top 3 most-viewed YouTube Shorts of all time [16][12]
  • 'Anaya Ke Dance Ke Liye Ek Like To Banta Hai 👍🏻❤️' — 2.54B views, uploaded Nov 24, 2023 [12]
  • 'MY FIRST VLOG ON YOUTUBE || ANAYA KANDHAL' — 4.2M views, uploaded Aug 27, 2022 — earliest known public upload [8][9]
  • Multiple 'Anaya Kandhal Live Video' streams (compilations of shorts clips) each with hundreds of millions of views [14]

NOTE ON ~117B VIEW COUNT: The extraordinarily high lifetime view count (~117B–118B) is primarily attributable to the channel's dominance in YouTube Shorts, where individual shorts accumulate billions of views. This is not anomalous for this channel given its strategy of posting dozens of shorts daily that repeatedly go viral in India's massive short-form video market.
